modes.label: Layout
modes.summary: Viewport navigation, scene framing, and placement overlays stay lightweight so the stage reads like a blocking battlefield.

modes.label: Model
modes.summary: Topology work favors edge readability, selection clarity, and aggressive edit feedback around the active target.

modes.label: Sculpt
modes.summary: Brush energy dominates the frame; brush radius, surface response, and deformation warning overlays stay close to the cursor.

modes.label: Paint
modes.summary: Texture authoring and mask work keep layer, channel, and brush overlays visible without burying the paint surface.

modes.label: Lookdev
modes.summary: Material evaluation keeps preview lighting, deformation, UV policy, and export-ready diagnostics in the viewport frame.

modes.label: Render
modes.summary: Preview, pathtrace, accumulation, denoise, and review capture all stay explicit so the viewport reads like a production render room.
